title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration
author: Ravi Patel
title_and_description: Eval harness: per-prompt regression CI hook and eval-metrics integration — Adds a new CI job to run per-prompt regression checks during PRs and uploads aggregated eval metrics to internal monitoring. Context: regressions in prompt sets have caused subtle quality drops that escaped unit tests. This change introduces a lightweight evaluation hook that runs the eval-harness against a curated set of prompts for changed models/prompt-sets, compares recent baselines in S3, and fails the job if any metric regresses beyond configured thresholds. Key points: 1) New GitHub Actions job `eval/prompt-regression` (runs on PRs and on-demand) that uses the existing eval-harness runner with a per_prompt flag. 2) Threshold config: .eval/thresholds.yaml added (per-prompt and global fallbacks). 3) Metrics integration: eval results are published to internal metrics ingest (via eval-metrics/uploader) with tags (repo, pr_number, prompt_set). 4) Conservative defaults: job is non-blocking for release branch by default but blocks merges to main for codeowners-owned prompt-sets. 5) Includes a canary mode and a `--dry-run` switch for maintainers. Migration notes: Existing eval-harness infra required a small refactor to expose prompt-scoped execution and result serialization. The change includes tests and a documentation update in docs/eval/ci-hooks.md. Checklist: - [x] Add GH Action job and runner script - [x] Add thresholds config + default values - [x] Expose per-prompt execution in eval-harness - [x] Add uploader for metrics and tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] E2E smoke tested on branch

release_notes: Adds a new eval-harness CI job for per-prompt regression checks and an opt-in metrics uploader. Operators must set EVAL_METRICS_ENABLE to true in repository secrets to enable metric uploads. Default thresholds provided in .eval/thresholds.yaml.
